description: Register an AI Agent in the ChainRay A2A Agent Card registry. Requires agentId, name, and capabilities array. Auto-attaches KYA trust score if paymentAddress provided. Returns registration status. ($0.05)

agentId.description: Unique agent identifier (address, ENS, or custom ID)

capabilities.description: Agent capabilities: swap, bridge, monitor, analyze, trade, etc.

chain.description: EVM chain only. Supported chains: base, ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bsc, avalanche, zksync, linea, scroll, blast, mantle, gnosis, polygon-zkevm, mode, sei, celo, manta, taiko, fantom, cronos, opbnb, zora, worldchain, metis, fraxtal, kava, zetachain, filecoin, core-dao, aurora, moonbeam, klaytn, bob, canto, monad, tempo, megaeth, arc, plasma, katana, robinhood, pharos, hyperevm.

paymentAddress.description: Wallet address for receiving payments (triggers KYA scoring)

updateToken.description: Private ownership token returned when this agent was first registered

name: agent.card.register
title: Agent Card Register
